decisions.why: Examples reference "High Volume Hdf" (haemodiafiltration) and "Milestones In Dialysis", confirming this is haemodialysis equipment.

Examples name "Ecmo Therapy Critical Care" and "Novalung", an ECMO/extracorporeal life-support platform built on oxygenator and centrifugal-pump technology matching cardiopulmonary bypass and perfusion.
